pr_body:
I ran into the same issue that @pgr0ss noticed while integrating the generate workspace tool into my workflow. So, without much context, I attempted to solve #1520. 

This is my first foray into bazel's codebase, so I welcome feedback on my code. I think the option handling code could be improved with a refactor at this point or in the future.

cc/ @kchodorow
pr_title: Add new options to generate workspace
